tspan.tspan: Prices in Kerala are rising seven times as fast as in India overall
Year‐on‐year change in consumer prices, December 2025. Kerala’s 9.49% compares with 1.33% for
India; across most of the country prices barely moved. Manipur, at −4.23%, saw them fall.
Source: MOSPI (CPI, base 2012, combined rural and urban)
